en: In the bosom of my Father, I ‘ve found the shelter from all harm
My Lord holds me up and carries me,
I am surrounded with His perfect peace

ko: 주 내 안에 거하며 나를 붙드시니
en: Though I may stumble and worry and disstressed I know that Jesus dwells in me and He holds me close all right
When Jesus alone is the center of my heart I will be clothed with the true peace from above

ko: 주 약속 안에서 내 영혼 평안해
내 뜻보다 크신 주님의 계획 나 신뢰해
en: I’ll always be at peace in the promise of my Lord Knowing much greater is His plan than mine, so I fully trust in Him
Putting aside all my fears, I trust the Lord alone I’ve found the shelter from all harm in Jesus Christ the Lord
